confidence_interval_method: 5000 bootstrap draws with persona as the resampling unit; percentile 95% interval.
nll_definition: negative log-probability normalized over the four permitted labels
limitations: Question rows are correlated within personas; confidence intervals resample personas.
No selector training, retrieval, or judge model is involved.

Each question follows its entire official 32K source history, quoted as a chronological role-labelled transcript. Source system messages are preserved. CSV persona profiles, preferences, and reference snippets are not added.
Use training personas for selector fitting, validation personas for tuning, and test personas for final reporting.
32K is measured by the source tokenizer; the actual Qwen context may need to be larger.
CPU offload can change latency and device-memory use; runtime settings are recorded in the protocol.
This is a fixed whole-persona subset evaluation, not the full PersonaMem-v2 benchmark.
resource_measurement: Memory averages are the arithmetic mean of per-question averages. Poll about once per second during scoring; requests with no poll use an immediate post-response snapshot. Missing measurements are null and excluded from averages; coverage counts are reported. GPU readings include other processes; RAM is the llama-server working set only. Runtime includes prompt formatting, template/tokenization HTTP requests, and all scoring attempts, including recovery restart overhead but excluding initial model startup and post-response memory sampling.

hardware.scope: All native server sessions in the most recent evaluator invocation; per-question aggregate metrics also include resumed predictions.
hardware.gpu_memory_measurement: Device-wide NVIDIA GPU memory, including desktop/other processes. Samples start after each model startup.
hardware.host_memory_measurement: Windows llama-server process working set, including mapped model pages and CPU offload; excludes Python/evaluator RAM.
